title: The home page, /discover, North County and the sitemap load every website theme block through one data file

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (backwards test: production script chunks traced to their import chain)

detail: Mega pass 2026-11-19. On production the 183 KB theme-kit client chunk (Wildheart, Temple, Network kit, Free Human calendar and wheel, every kit's contact and letter forms) loaded on /, /discover, /north-county-san-diego, /pricing, /about and /events, and not on /help, /for, /vs or /themes. Tracing the static imports from each page found the cause for the first three and the sitemap: lib/spaces/discovery.ts (a data module) -> lib/sites/profile-canonical.ts and lib/spaces/profile-pages.ts -> lib/page-editor/templates/space.ts -> lib/page-editor/config.tsx, the whole Puck block registry. profile-pages needed only the pure isWellFormedSpaceDoc shape check, but its module also builds KNOWN_BLOCKS from the config. The same chain reached the member app's root layout, app/(main)/layout.tsx, through the Vera launcher's server actions (vera-actions -> spaces/[slug]/manage/layout/actions -> profile-pages), so every member page's server bundle carried the registry too. Fix: the shape check moves to lib/page-editor/templates/space-doc.ts (no block imports); templates/space.ts re-exports it so its callers are unchanged, and profile-pages imports the pure module. This is the cause PERF-013 names for the anonymous public pages it lists; pages that render the block editor themselves (/pricing, /about and the other Puck-backed marketing routes) still import the config and stay with PERF-013.

verify.note: Fails on main: all four reach lib/page-editor/config.tsx through profile-pages. Passes when none does.
